cloze.instruction: 阅读节选，为每一空选择最符合原文语境的选项，每题只有一个正确答案。

parts.text: The faster foods are frozen, the smaller the ice crystals that form, resulting in less damage to the cells. That is why

frozen fruits and vegetables retain their texture much better than those you freeze at home, as industrial freezing systems freeze foods much more rapidly.

Certain dairy products, including milk, and high-fat foods, such as

and cream, are also not good to freeze because the fat can separate, changing the taste and texture of the food.

Mayonnaise is particularly problematic because it is an emulsion – a mixture of oil and water – held together by

such as egg yolk. Ice crystals can disrupt this emulsion, causing the mixture to separate during thawing.

What freezes well?

Foods that don’t rely on intact cells generally freeze well. These include rice, pasta, bread, soups, sauces, stews,

dough and pastry.

Freezing raw meat to later thaw and cook retains the overall quality very well.

But cooked meat can become drier after freezing, because moisture has been lost during cooking. However, this is less of an issue for meat in

where it is surrounded by liquid, such as sauces or stews.

Mixed dishes, such as curries, casseroles, bolognese sauces, chilli corn carne and soups, are particularly

-friendly because the ingredients are already cooked and surrounded by liquid or sauce.

Vegetables that are higher in fibre, such as carrots and peas, retain their texture quite well after freezing and thawing.

Cooked vegetables also freeze and thaw well because the cooking process changes their structure and the texture is no longer

upon intact water-filled cells. Cooking also helps to stop processes that contribute to food deteriorating.

Herbs freeze very well and retain much of their flavour. However, they tend to lose their

texture after thawing, making them better suited to cooked dishes than garnishes.

Wash and thoroughly dry herbs before freezing them whole, or put them in ice cube trays with a little water or oil. Once frozen, transfer the herb cubes to

containers or freezer bags, and add them directly to cooking without thawing first.

Does freezing affect nutrition?

Freezing does not necessarily make food less nutritious. In fact, frozen fruits and vegetables can retain most of their
because freezing slows the chemical reactions that would otherwise cause nutrient losses over time.

reading.title: 主旨、理解与信息定位
reading.instruction: 阅读原文后回答 5 道选择题：1 道主旨、1 道内容理解、1 道段落细节、2 道信息定位。段落细节题以题干指定段落为准。

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the overall focus of this article?
options: Research compares heat and cold as approaches to recovery after exercise.
Mammograms may reveal information about cardiovascular health as well as breast cancer.
The physical properties of foods explain why freezing and thawing affect their textures differently.
Blood changes may provide clues to very early processes associated with ovarian cancer.
questions.explanation: 把标题与全文各段的中心内容连起来判断主旨，避免把同一主题下的其他话题当成本文重点。
questions.evidence: A simple rule of thumb: foods that rely on being crisp for their texture tend to freeze poorly – think of a cucumber – while foods that are already soft, cooked, mixed or liquid often freeze well.

questions.prompt: Why can faster freezing help preserve food texture?
options: It makes all foods chemically identical.
It ensures that thawing can never occur.
It produces smaller ice crystals and less cell damage.
It prevents water from existing inside food.
questions.explanation: 第 6 段提供了作答依据。正确选项用不同说法表达了文中的信息；请比较范围、数量、因果关系与限定词。
questions.evidence: The faster foods are frozen, the smaller the ice crystals that form, resulting in less damage to the cells.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is explicitly made in paragraph 14?
options: To help retain quality, foods should be frozen in a leak-proof container, freezer bag or other airtight packaging.
Vegetables that are higher in fibre, such as carrots and peas, retain their texture quite well after freezing and thawing.
The faster foods are frozen, the smaller the ice crystals that form, resulting in less damage to the cells.
It’s fine to put warm food straight into the freezer, you don’t need to refrigerate it first.
questions.explanation: 定位第 14 段，比较四个选项的具体信息。其余选项来自本文其他段落，并非本段明确陈述的内容。
questions.evidence: Vegetables that are higher in fibre, such as carrots and peas, retain their texture quite well after freezing and thawing.
